title: Ideas: Language technologies for everyone with Kalika Bali
description: The new series “Ideas” debuts with guest Kalika Bali. The speech and language tech researcher talks sci-fi and its impact on her career, the design thinking philosophy behind her research, and the “outrageous idea” she had to work with low-resource languages. The post Ideas: Language technologies for everyone with Kalika Bali appeared first on Microsoft Research .
